scenarioFindings.rationale: Checked painful-knee constraint for both outward and return journeys, companion already upstairs, waiting downstairs if no verified stair-free return route, and five corresponding Japanese-production hints in all twelve languages. No unsupported assurance of accessibility added.

Checked two diners, whole-fish versus grill-size constraint, remaining-bone warning without boneless guarantee, and conditional choice of other portions. All twelve languages and five hints preserve the safety condition. Improved Vietnamese location wording and Thai embedded-question grammar.

Read all twelve locales and task hints against the complete calligraphy exchange: phonetic kanji is not an official name translation; the learner selects normal katakana, practices ink and spacing, dries the work and avoids stacking wet surfaces. Corrected Vietnamese hợp âm, which normally denotes a musical chord, to explicit matching pronunciation.

Compared all twelve sentence/hint sets with the carrier-plan exchange: device debt is independent from communications contract, discounts must be compared after expiry, workplace calls and initial fees remain part of total comparison, and no contract is signed today. Corrected Hindi comparison syntax and Tagalog materials wording.

Read the whole twelve-language transit-card exchange and hints. Preserved uncertainty about the failure cause, the discovery that a different card paid previously, route/card compatibility before top-up, cash fallback and payment timing before boarding. Corrected Vietnamese timing hint and Bengali card-payment wording and flustered-versus-busy distinction.

All twelve locales and hints read with the changing gift date, tomorrow overtime leading to possible handover in two days, no knife in the recipient dorm, small manageable fruit portions, product-specific storage information and photo privacy. Clarified recipient eating subject in Vietnamese, hand preparation and photograph request in Tagalog, Hindi comparison syntax.

Read full twelve-language bill-dispute exchange and hints: friend placed a genuine additional order while learner was absent; error allegation is withdrawn; drink abbreviations identify draft beer and oolong; separate payment is unavailable and learner settles total then reimburses privately using receipt. Restored literal Japanese bill symbols in English and Burmese, fixed Chinese breakdown wording.

Reviewed twelve locales and five hints against cattle-passage work safety context: worker stays outside cattle route, does not open gate or drive stopped animal, identifies supervisor through work-sheet mark, waits for area/start-signal/standing-position instructions and demonstration.
